title: Blank oracle-choice transition
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ be an oracle language over that alphabet, and let $x$ be an input word. Suppose a configuration $d$ of the associated oracle machine has state $q$, where $q$ is not $N$’s query state, and the extra choice tape is blank at its head position. Then one step relative to $O$ leaves the tapes and head positions unchanged, sets the state to the halting state, and appends the Boolean symbol false to the output.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Bool
O is a language over Bool
d is a configuration on input x with the associated machine's work tapes and state type
q differs from the embedded query state of N
the choice tape is blank at its head position
